Calculate an ARMA unit-innovation response

Source: R/02-generics.R
response.Rd

Evaluate how a unit residual innovation is propagated by the supplied AR and optional MA coefficients.

Usage

response(x, ..., ma_parameters = numeric(), steps = 480L)

Arguments

x

An AR parameter object.

...

Additional method arguments; currently unused.

ma_parameters

Numeric MA coefficients ordered from most recent to oldest residual. Use numeric() for an AR-only response.

steps

Positive whole number of response timesteps.

Value

An ARMA response result containing component contributions and total error through time.

Examples

parameters <- default_ar_parameters()

unit_response <- response(
  parameters,
  ma_parameters = c(-0.5, -0.25),
  steps = 48L
)

head(unit_response@series)
#>     step ar_contribution ma_contribution residual_contribution arma_error
#>    <int>           <num>           <num>                 <num>      <num>
#> 1:     0        0.000000            0.00                     1   1.000000
#> 2:     1        1.765000           -0.50                     0   1.265000
#> 3:     2        1.506475           -0.25                     0   1.256475
#> 4:     3        1.258316            0.00                     0   1.258316
#> 5:     4        1.256983            0.00                     0   1.256983
#> 6:     5        1.253640            0.00                     0   1.253640
